Variants.Content: A manor was sustained by granaries, tenants, mills, and patience, not just by swords hanging in the halls. The lord's wife, steward and bachelor can see whether the year's harvest is good in the account book, and the farmer can feel the master's temperament from the taxes and labor; an account book that remembers it too clearly, can also be more feared than a spear.
